value.rationale: Successive rough approximations are order dependent. Alternating two-element partitions on cycles are a minimal connected regular overlap family, so the proved sharp transition between four elements and longer cycles plus exact exponential agreement decay is a motivated quantitative stability phenomenon. The join-component criterion also handles arbitrary pairs of partitions; the result is not just an arbitrary table or a standard recurrence.
